_comment: Fallback values used by the style map when a file's channel is unreliable (flat velocity, quantized timing). Starter values come from Trell's confirmed production principles in trell_music_life/README.md. Edit freely as taste evolves.

microtiming._why: Senn et al. 2016: deviations ~25ms+ reliably lowered groove ratings

per_style_weight._why: Trell decision 2026-07-12: quantized hats groove fine in trap; hand-played feel matters in neo-soul/melodic parts

rolls._why: constant rolls = arpeggiator sound; 1 roll per 4 bars is right

bass_808_frame.tuning: 808 audio sample, root at middle C = C3 = MIDI 60 (Ableton naming); deliver basslines in this frame, no manual pitching
bass_808_frame.bar1_ceiling: most of bar 1 never a full octave+ above middle C — notes above C4 (71+) fold down
bass_808_frame.bar_endings: never exactly one octave below the root; finish on the root, or the b7 if the bar begins on the root
bass_808_frame.retired_structure: a bar whose notes ALL sit >= root+7 (the out-there counter shape: +8, octave, octave, octave, +5) — fold alternating notes down an octave to create intra-bar bounce (e.g. D4->D3, C4->C3 against A3)
bass_808_frame._why: Trell evolved standards 2026-07-13 after trial 06: every wrong-lane bassline mark relates to these rules

bass_register_shape.bounce: shifting between high and low registers back/forth creates bounce
bass_register_shape.drop: shifting high to low creates a drop feeling
bass_register_shape._why: Trell feedback 2026-07-13 (trial 02): liked register shifting for bounce, but the 4-bar loop must resolve to the low register; v04 (low bar 1, high bars 2-4) was the counter-example

melody_rules.phrases_cross_barlines: pickups into the next bar + sustained tails; bar-boxed phrases read as random notes
melody_rules._why: Trell feedback 2026-07-13 (trial 02): blended vocab = high-pitch random notes; only structure was bar containment
